'tshig slob dpon rang yang tshig la khad pa byung ste/ der mu stegs phyir song ngo*/ bdag gi sems can 'di gcig bu'i don yang mi nus na gzhan ltar smos snyam sems bskyed btang bar brtsams pa na/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal mngon sum du byon nas/ bu ma byed ma byed skye bo dman dang 'phrad na blo gros ngan skye 200)ste/ khyod kyi bstan bcos 'di la mu stegs sogs kyi gnod mi nus par shes/ khyod kyi sangs rgyas ma thob bar du dge ba'i bshes su nga 'gyur gyis phyi ma'i dus su bstan bcos kun gyi mig gcig tu ni 'di 'gyur ro/ zhes gsungs pas/ slob dpon gyis/ bzod ka'i sdug bsngal du ma dang ldan brnag dka' la/ sems kyang dam pa min pa'i spyod pa la dga' zhing*/ skye bo dam pa 'phrad dka' gal te khyod kyi zhal mthong yang*/ bdag la byin gyis ma rlobs de la ci bgyid mchis zhes zhus pas/ bu ma dga' bar ma byed cig nyam nga ba thams cad la bdag gis bsrung ngo*/ zhes gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur ro/ de nas bstan bcos de yang legs par brtsams/ lan gcig mnal ba'i dus sangs rgyas mang po'i zhal mthong*/ lho phyogs kyi rgyud du yul tha dad kyi mu stegs kyis rgol ba rnams tshar bcad/ sngon gyi slob dpon rnams kyis gtsugs 201)pa'i chos gzhi nyams pa rnams sor chud par mdzad/ slar yang o ḍi bi sha'i rgyal po'i blon po bha dra pa li ta ces bya ba rgyal po'i mdzod kyi spyan pa yin pa de sangs kyi bstan pa la bcug ste/ des gtsug lag kang bcu drug bzhengs/ de rer dge 'dun gyi sde chen po re dang chos gzhi re yang yod par byas/ dge 'dun de rnams khrims rnam par dag pa'i rtags su bram ze'i bskyed mos tshal du nad thams cad gso bar nus pa'i muṣ+ṇi ha ri ra ka zhes bya ba a ru ra'i sdong po khyad 'phags shig skyes pa sogs 'gro phan ni dpag par dka'/ chos kyi 'brel ba'i slob mas phyogs thams cad la khyab/

'dod chung chog shes pas ji srid 'tsho'i bar du sbyangs yon bcu gnyis la gnas nas mthar o ḍi bi sha'i nags tshal dben pa zhig tu sku 'das so/ btsun pa dge 'dun 'bangs ni/ slob dpon dbyig gnyeran gyi slob ma zhig ste 202)yul lho phyogs pa bram ze'i rigs/ sde pa thams cad yod smra yin/ rdo rje gdan du yun ring bzhugs nas der 'dul ba dang mngon pa'i chos gzhi nyi shu rtsa bzhi gtsug kha cher byon nas rin chen snas pa'i gtsug lag khang dang*/ kum+bha ku ṣ+ṇi li'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ theg chen mang du spel/ kha che'i yul der sngon thogs med sku mched kahayis thege na cung zad dar/ slob dpon 'dis phyis dar rgyas mdzad nas mthar yul de nyid du sku 'das so/ slob dpon chos 'bangs ni/ shar phyogs bhaṅga lar 'khrungs/ sku mched gnyis kyi slob ma yin/ phyogs bzhir 'jam dpal gyi lha khang re bzhengs/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa yongs rdzogs pa 'grel pa mdzad do ces grags/ slob dpon sangs rgyas bskyangs ni lho phyogs tam+bha la'i yul du 'khrungs/ slob dpon klu'i bshes gnyen gyi slob ma slob dpon dge 'dun bsrung ba las klu sgrub kyi gzhung lugs rnams thos par byas nas 203)bsgoms pas ye shes mchog brnyed/ 'jam dpal gyi zhal gzig 'phags pa yab sras dang slob dpon dpa' bo sogs kyi gzhung lugs mang por rnam bshad mdzad/ mthar ri lu'i dngos grub bsgrub pas 'grub bo/ slob dpon legs ldan ni/ lho phyogs mang rgya rar rgyal rigs su skye ba brnyes/ yul de nyid du rab ta byung sde snod gsum la mkhas par sbyangs/ dbus su byon nas slob dpon dge 'dun bsrung ba las theg chen gyi mdo sde du ma dang klu sgrub kyi man ngag nos te/ slar yang lho phyogs su byon nas phyag rdor gyi zhal gzigs chos mang du bstan/ slob dpon sangs rgyas bskyangs sku 'das des mdzad pa'i bstan bcos rnams gzigs/

dbu ma rtsa ba'i gzhung las slob dpon snga ma'i bzhed pa de sun phyungs te 'grel pa mdzad cing klu sgrub kyi man ngag la brten par zhal gyis bzhes nas/ mdo sde 'ga' zhig la 'gril pa 204)mdzad do/ de la slob dpon 'di gnyis kyi dbu ma ngo bo nyid med par smra ba'i gzhung gtsugs shing*/ sangs rgyas bskyangs slob ma ha cang mang ba ma yin yang*/ legs ldan gyi slob ma shin tu mang bas dge slong stong phrag du ma rjes su 'brang ba yin pas lugs de byin tu dar bar gyur ro/ slob dpon 'di gnyis la byon gong du theg chen mtha' dag bstan gcig tu gnas/ slob dpon 'di gnyis kyis klu sgrub dang thogs med gnyis shin tu tha dad de/ thogs med kyi ge dbu ma'i lam mi ston sems tsam kho na yin la/ kho bo cag gi 'di las gzhan du med do zhes mtha' gzhan 'gog par mdzad pas legs ldan sku 'das pa'i 'og tu theg chen la'ang nang du sde gnyis su gyes rtsod pa byung ngo*/ bod rnams sangs rgyas bskyangs klu sgrub kyi sku tshe'i stod kyi slob ma dang*/ legs ldan sku tshe'i smad kyis slob ma yin pa dang*/ rtsod pa byas pa skad dang*/ sangs rgyas bskyangs zla grags su 205)skye ba bzhis zer ba sogs rig pas gras pa'i bcol gtam du zad do/ 'phags pa rnam grol ste ni yul dbus dang lho phyogs kyi mtshams 'bar ba'i phug dang nye bar 'khrungs/ sangs rgyas 'bangs kyi dbon po yin zhing*/ theg chen la mos nas dbyig gnyen gyi drung du byon/ sher phyin nyan nas de'i mdo sde rnams yongs rdzogs bzung*/ 'on kyang man ngag ma gsan no/ slar slob dpon dge 'dun bsrung ba la gsan par grags/ slob dpon 'di bod la grags pa ltar na/ dbyig gnyen gyi slob ma phar phyir rang la mkhas pa de yin zer/ rgya gar ba 'ga' zhig ni phyogs glang gi slob ma dang*/ dbyig gnyen gyi zhabs kyang ma zin/ sher phyin yang slob dpon chos 'bangs la gsan/

man ngag len nas ldan la zhus so zhes kyang zer/ gang ltar yang slob dpon 'dis sher phyin la bsam sgom mdzad pa'i 206)tshe don la the tshom med kyang mdo dang mngon rtogs kyi tshig 'ga' re mi 'byor ba byung ste thugs ma bde ba'i tshe/ mnal lam du byams pas wa ra ṇā ser don chen po brnyed par gyur ro/ zhes pa'i lung bstan byung ba ltar byon pas/ dge bsnyen zhi ba'i go cha lcags kyi byin pa can du grags pas/ lho phyog po ta la nas nyi khri le brgyad ma'i dpe spyan drangs pa dang 'dzom/ mdo tshig rgyan dang mthun par byung bas dbugs dbyung thob bo/ slob dpon des mdo le'u brgyad ma dang*/ mngon rtogs rgyan ngo bo nyid med par smra ba'i dbu ma'i don du bkral ba dang*/ mdo rgyan bsres pa'i bstan bcos mdzad pa po yin/ 'di ma byung ba'i sngon rol du de ltar med/ nyi khri snang bar sngon chad gzhan gyis ma myong gsung ba'i rgyu mtshan de ltar yin no zer/ sher phyin rtsal bton gyi 'chad nyan dge slong tsho res nyung mtha' byas par lo 207)gsum tsam mdzad par grags/ rgya bod gnyis su sa dang po dang*/ sbyor lam pa dang*/ 'phags pa dang nye bas de'i khongs su gtogs pa yin zer yang*/ skyes mchog dam pa ngo mtshar can zhig yin par rtsod pa mi snang ngo*/ slob dpon dkon mchog gsum gyi 'bangs ni/ dbyig gnyen las mngon pa'i sde snod thos pa phyogs glang dang mdza' bshes su gyur pa de la sher phyin nyan pa'i slob ma zhig ste/ blo gros phyogs glang dang mnyam par grags shing*/ 'dis mdzad pa'i yon tan mtha' yas par bstod pa las/ phyogs glang gis bsdus don mdzad do/ slob dpon dkon mchog gsum gyi 'bangs slob dpon dpa' bo'i mtshan du 'dod cing*/ gang dag bstod pa brgya lnga bcu pa la/ phyogs glang gis spel mar bstod pa'i kha skongs mdzad ces smra ba ni rang bzo'am lo rgyus la dag pa'i rjes su phyogs par zad de/

spel mar bstod pa'i nang gi phyogs glang gi 208)gsung rnams bstod pa brgya lnga bcu pa'i tshigs bcad de dang de'i mtshams sbyor ram/ don gsal byed kho na yin pas/ 'grel par sbyar ba yin gyi slob dpon de gnyis kyis rtsom res byas pa ga la yin zhes go dgos so/ slad kyis slob dpon des lho phyogs su byon te gtsug lag khang du ma'i mnga' bdag mdzad nas skye bo du ma la chos bstan/ dra ba le'i yul du chos gzhi chen po lnga bcu tsam gsar du gtsug nas bstan pa yun ring du gsal bar mdzad/ mthar gnod sbyin mo bsgrub nas ri'i rgyal po me tog brgya pa ces bya bar bzhud do/ dge bsnyen zhi ba'i go chas po ta lar phyin pa yang 'di dag dang dus mtshungs pa ste/ de'i lo rgyus cung zad brjod na/ yul puṇ+ḍa wad+dha na'i nags tshal na/ dge bsnyen de spyan ras gzigs bsgrubs shing grub rtags kyang byung ba na/ rgyal po shu bha sa ra zhes pa'i rmis ltas su dge bsnyen 209)de yul 'dir spyan 'dren par ri bo po ta lar rdzongs shig ces pa rmis pas/ de la mu tig gi 'phreng ba dang spyen pa'i yi ge gtad/ lam rgyags pa ṇa dag kyang sbyin pa na/ dge gnyen gyis bsam par/ lam bsgrod dka' zhing ring bas srog gi bar chad kyang byed srid na 'on kyang yi dam gyi lha bzhugs par bskul ba'i ngag bcog par ni cha ma yin no snyams nas lam yig thogs nas song*/ mthar dha na shri'i gling dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten du sleb/ de nas po ta lar sa 'og cung zad brgyud nas phyin pa na/ slar sa steng nas 'gro sa yod pa deng sang rgya mtsho lud pas sa gzhi non te mis thar sa med gsung*/ sngon gyi dus de tsam na lam yod pas de las brgyud nas song*/ der chu bo chen po zhig la ma thar bar lam yig ltar sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas bsgral/ de nas mtshor ma thar 210)bar/ khro gnyer can gyis bsgral/

nags kyi me 'bar nas ma thar bar/ rta mgrin gyis char phab ste bsgral/ ngam grog 'jigs su rung bar/ ral gcig mas sbrul zam byas te bsgral/ de nas spre'u glang po che'i lus tsam mang pos lam bkag par/ don zhag gis de rnams bskrad de lam phye zhing bza' bca' bzang po dag kyang byin/ de nas ri bo ta la'i rtsar sleb kyang brag ri la ma thar spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba btab pas/ spa thag gi skas byung nas de la 'dzegs te phyin pa na/ phyogs thams cad rmugs pas non te lam ma rnyed yun ring du gsol ba btab pas na bun sangs song bar/ ri de'i sum cha la sgrol ma'i sku brnyan dang re sked na khro gnyer can gyi sku brnyan sogs mthong*/ ri'i rtse mor phyin pa na gzhal med khang stong pa me tog tho re ba las gzhan su yang mi 'dug go/ der gsol ba 'debs kyin 211)zla ba gcig tu sdad pa na/ nam zhig bud med gcig 'ongs nas 'phags pa byon pas 'dir shog gcig zer te khrid nas/ pho brang gi sgo rim pa stong phye ba las sgo re re phye bas ting nge 'dzin re re skyes/ 'phags pa lha lnga dang dngos su 'jal me tog sku la gtor/ rgyal po'i yi ge dang rten phul/ 'dzam bu'i gling du 'byon par gsol ba btabs pas zhal gyis bzhes te/ dge bsnyen la lam rgyags pa ṇa mang po gnang*/ 'di tsam gyis 'tsho ba la brten nas khyod yul du sleb par 'gyur gyis/ pa ṇa ma zad pa ṇa 'ong ngo*/ zhes gsungs shing lam bstan/ ri sked dang ri rtsa'i sum cha na yod pa'i sku brnyan 'tsho yang dngos su mthong*/ tshur 'ongs pa na zhag bcu gnyis song ba'i nyin mo/ puṇ+ḍa wa dha na'i ri mthong nas rab tu dga' ste/ pa ṇa lhag pos bza' btung lhag por nyos te zos/ rgyal po'i grong 212)khyer du ma slebs par rang gi sgrub gnas dang nye bar sleb pa'i tshe nas pa ṇa zad/ sa der sdad nas nyin rangs par 'phags pa 'byon nam sems pa na ma byon na phyed na gnyid la song ba rol mo'i sgras sad pa na bltas pas rgyab bsten gyi shing gi ngos la lha lnga dngos su byon 'dug par/

phyag btsal gsol ba btab/ rgyal po'i yul du 'byon par zhus pas dang po pa ṇa ma zad na/ de ltar yin yang da ni 'di kho nar gnas so gsungs/ de nas nags tshal der lha khang bzhengs pa kha sa pa ṇi'i lha khang du grags so/ de ltar ni rgya gar spyi khyab tu grags pa ltar yin/ nyi khri le'u brgyad pa'i lo rgyud ltar na/ rgyal pos bskul ba'i 'phros med par po ta lar lan gsum byon pa'i dang po rang nyid kyis mjal ba'i don dang*/ gnyis pa mod rgyan gnyis tshig ma mthun pa'i dogs gcod la wa ra ṇā si'i dge 'dun gyis btang bar/ dgos gcod ma zhus par kha sa pa ṇi 213)spyan drangs/ kha sa pa ṇi la zhus pas/ nga sprul pa yin pas mi shes gsungs pa lan gsum pa de'i dgos gcog la byon nas le'u brgyad la spyan drangs zer ro/ gang ltar yang dge bsnyen de yo byad la bltas nas tshom rkun pas bkrongs par brtsam pa'i tshe/ myong bar nges pa'i las kyi mthur shes nas/ mgo bo 'phags pa'i phyag tu phul zhig byas pas/ tshom rkun pas kyang de bzhin du byas/ 'phags pas spyan chab phyungs/ klad khu sa ru song bas/ de thams cad ring bsren du gyur/ de phyin nas mchod pa dngos su ma bzhes zhes grags so/ de nas rgyal po shri ha ra sha'i bu rgyal po ngang tshul zhes bya ba byung nas/ dkon mchog mchod pa'i rgyal por gyur nas lo brgya dang bzhi bcu thub rgyal srid kyang lo brgyar nye ba byas/ 'di skabs yon tan 'od kyi sku tshe'i gzhug tsam yin par grags/ 214)shar du rgyal po li tsa wa'i rigs las byung ba seṅge zhes bya ba mnga' thang chen po zhig kyang byung*/ de'i dus slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mi 'khrungs/ seṅge'i bu rgyal po bha ra bzhes bya bas kyang rgyal srid ring du byas/ 'di skabs legs ldan dang 'phags pa grol sde'i sku tshe'i smad kyi dus yin/ slob dpon nyi ma sbas pa grol sde'i slob ma mchog ste dang*/ sangs rgyas brkyangs kyi slob ma ka ma la bud+dhi'i sku tshe smad dang*/

yon tan 'od kyi slob ma zla ba'i nor bu dang*/ na len+d+ra'i mkhan chen rgyal ba'i lha rnams dus mtshungs su byung zhing*/ lho phyogs su slo dpon zla ba grags pa'ang byon/ slob dpon chos skyong dang*/ zhi ba lha dang*/ grub thob bi ru pa'i sku tshe'i stod kyi dus tsam mo/ 'phags pa lha yang 'di dus byung bar mngon ste/ me tog phreng rgyud shes rab grags kyis bsgyur ba na/ 'phags pa dge 'dun 'bangs kyi slob ma/ 'phags pa sa ga 215)lhas mdzad pa ces 'byung ba bo/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pa ni/ lho phyogs man+tar sku 'khrungs/ chung ngu nyid nas rig gnas mtha' dag la sbyangs/ rab tu byung zhing sde snod mtha' dag la mkhas par byas/ legs ldan gyi slob ma mang po dang*/ sangs rgyas brkyangs kyi slob ma ka ma la budhi la/ klu sgrub kyi gzhung lugs dang man ngag thams cad nos/ mkhas pa chen por gyur nas dpal na len+d+ra'i mkhan po mdzad/ rtsa 'jug gzhi gsum dang*/ rigs bsrug bcu pa'i 'grel pa la sogs pa mdzad de sangs rgyas brkyangs kyi lugs de nyid cher dar bar mdzad pa yin no/ ri mor bris pa'i ba la 'o ma dang rtsig pa sogs la thogs med du bzhugad pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma yod cing*/ mu stegs kyi sgol ba mang po tshar bcad/ bram ze dang khyim bdag phal cher 216)bstan pa la bcug nas chos gzhi chen po mang du btab/ mthar sngags lam la brten nas mchog thob par bzhed/ bod kyi lo rgyus ltar na dgung lo sum brgya bzhugs par grags so/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mi ni/ spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal mthong ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta mu stegs rgyang 'phen pa'i ston pa zhig dang rtsod par gyur te/ de'i ring lugs sun phyungs yang rig pa ni blos snar brtags pa yin pas gang blo bsgren pa de rgyal ba yin gyi/ skye ba snga phyi yod pa'i rtags mngon sum du med pas kho bo cag mi 'dod zer ba na/ der rgyal po la sogs dpang por bzhag ste/

nga nyid skye ba len pa yin pas dpral bar rtags thob cig byas nas/ des dpral bar tshal gyi thig le sha la thim pa gcig byas/ kha nang du mu tig gcig bcug nas de nyid du 'das te/ de'i lus zangs kha sbyor gyi nang du bcug 217)nas rgyal pos rgya btab bo/ de rgyal rigs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta bi shi sa ga zhes pa'i bur skye bar khas blangs pa bzhin de la khyi'u mtshan dang ldan pa zhig btsas ma thag tu tshal gyi ri mo dpral bar yod pa kha nang du mu tig yod pa de byung*/ rgyal po sogs kyis sngar gyi phung po de bltas pas dpral ba'i mtshal gyi ri mo yang byed/ mu tig gi shul har re 'dug der mu stegs de yang skye ba snga phyi yod par yid che skad/ khyi'u btsas ma thag tu ma la phyag byas te zla ba bcur 'o ma rgyal lam byas pas/ btsas ma thag smra ba ltas na no snyam nas kha rog 'dug byas pas lo bdun bar cang ma smras pas lkug pa'o snyam mo/ der mu stegs kyi rgol ba shin tu go dka' ba snyan par gas kyi tshigs bcad sangs rgyas pa rnams kahayi grub mtha' 'gog par byed pa gcig brtsams nas rgyal po dang mkhas pa'i 218)tshogs thams cad la grims so/ der bi she sa ga'i khyim du byung ba na/ don de yun ring brtags pas ma go bas lan gdab par ga la nus/ lan gcig bya ba zhig gi phyir khyim gyi phyi rol du song ba na/ der tsan+d+ra go mi lo bdun 'gro ba des bltas pa na/ don de shes par dka' ba med do/ don 'grol gyi yig chung btab/ lan gyi tshigs bcad kyang bris so/ phas nang du 'ongs pa na de ltar bris pa mthong nas/ khyim du su byung zhes tsan+d+ra go mi'i ma la bris so/ gzhan su yang ma 'ongs bu lkug pas blta zhing bris so/ der phas bu la dris pa na ma'i gdong la blta zhing 'dug go/ mas smros shig byas pas/ 'di ni bdag gis bris te rgol ba 'di bzlog pa ni dka' ba ma yin zhes zer/ de nas nang par tsan+d+ra go mi dang mu stegs kyi ston pa de gnyis brtsod pas tsan+d+ra go mi rgyal te bya dga' chen po thob phyogs

219)thams cad du mkhas pa'i grags pas khyab bo/ de nas slob dpon blo gros bstan pa la mdo sde dang mngon pa'i sde snod phal cher lan gcig gsan pas mkhyen/ rig 'dzin gyi slob dpon mya ngan med par bka' lung nos te rigs sngags bsgrub pas spyan ras gzigs dang sgrol ma'i zhal gzigs/ de nas shar phyogs rgyal po bha ra sha'i yul du sman dpyad dang sdeb sbyor sogs gzo'i gnas kyi bstan bcos mang du byas/ khyad par sgra rig pa mang du bshad/ de'i tshe rgyal po'i bu mo ta ra zhes bya ba bag mar blangs shing rgyal pos yul 'khor zhig kyang sbyin par byas/ dus lan gcig g.yog mos tā ra 'bod kyin 'dug pas/ yi dam dang mtshan mthun pa khyim thags su mi rung ngo snyam nas/ yul gzhan du 'gro bar brtsams pas rgyal pos shes te/ nga'i bu mo dang lhan gcig mi 'dug na 220)gaṅgā la bskur cig ces bsgos te de bzhin byas pa na/ slob dpon gyis sgrol mar gsol ba btab bas/ gaṅgā dang rgya mtsho 'phrad mtshams kyi rgya mtsho'i gling zhig la thon/ gling de 'phags mas sprul ba yin yang zer te tsan+d+ra de pa ces bya ba da lta yang yod de grong bdun stong tsam shong ba zig 'dug zer/ spyan ras gzigs kyis lung bstan ba la gong ma'i dge bsnyen mdzad/ mtshan tsan+d+ra yin la/ de phyin chad nas tsan+d+ra go mer grags so/ slar yang 'dzam gling lho phyogs kyi rgyud du byon/ bram ze mchog srid kyi lha khang na klu la sgra nyan pa'i bkod pa dang*/ klu she ṣas byas pa'i pā ṇi'i 'grel pa 'dug pa yang gzigs pas/ klu ni rab tu rmongs pas/ tshig mang ba/ don nyung ba zlos pa/ ma rdzogs pa'o/ zhes smad nas/ pā ṇi pa'i don 'grel du tsan+d+ra byā ka ra ṇa yan lag dang bcas pa mdzad/ gzhung der/ nyung 221)ngu rnams gsal yang dag rdzogs/ zhes gsungs ba yang klu la zur za ba'o/ de nas dpal na len+d+rar byon/ de'i tse mkhan por gyur pa zla ba grags pa yin pa dang mjal nas/

khyed gang nas 'ongs byas pas/ lho phyogs nas 'ongs/ chos gang shes dris pas/ sgra pā ṇi pa dang*/ bstod pa brgya lnga bcu pa dang*/ mtshan yang dag pa brjod pa gsum shes byas pas/ 'di gzhung gsum las mi shes ces tshig khengs skyung yang*/ don la thams cad shes par khas blangs pa yin pas/ tsan+d+ra go mi yin nam snyam dris pas/ 'jig rten na de ltar grags gsungs/ 'o na mkhas pa chen po thog babs su byon pa ma legs kyis/ dge 'dun gyis bsu ba byed dgos pas re zhig grong khyer du bzhud cig gsungs pas/ bdag dge bsnyen ma dge 'dun gyis bsu ba byar ga la rung*/ 'di la thabs yod do gsungs nas/ shing rta 222)gsum las/ dbus mar 'jam dpal bzhugs/ gzhan gnyis su slob dpon gnyis kyis rnga yab g.yab cing 'dun nas dge 'dun gyis bsu ba dang bcas byon na 'jam dpal gyi sku la bsu ba byas par 'gro gsungs nas/ de ltar byas pas tsan+d+ra go mir 'jam dpal gyi sku bsnyan gyis zhal bstan pas der bstod pa mdzad pa sku bsnyan zhal phyir log gis gsan pa dus der skye bo kun gyis mthong nas sku gzugs pha gi ni de ltar byed do byas pa de kha la lus te 'jam dbyangs 'jing yon mar grags/ de nas tsan+d+ra go thogs med srol la brten te rnam rig gi phyogs bzung*/ zla grags ni klu sgrub kyi gzhung sangs rgyas bskyangs sogs kyis bkral ba la brten te ngo bo nyid med par smra ba'i phyogs bzung*/ lo bdun gyi bar du bgro gleng gi brgal brtag mdzad do/ rtsod pa de blta ba'i phyir skye bo mang po rtag tu 'dus pas/ grong pa'i khyi'u dang bu 223)mo tshun chad kyis kyang phyogs tsam rig nas/ kye ma 'phags pa klu sgrub gzhung*/ la la'i sman la la la'i dug mi pham 'phags pa thogs med gzhung*/ skye bo kun la bdud rtsi nyid/ ces glur len pa byung ngo*/ zla grags kyi dgongs par/ 'di la rtsod pa slob mi zhig yod do bsams nas/

tsan+d+ra go mi'i phyi bzhin phyin pa spyan ras gzigs kyi lha khang zhig yod par/ sgo'i phyi nas nyan pas/ spyan ras gzigs kyi rdo sku des slob dpon gyis slob ma la ston pa bzhin chos gsung ba gzigs pas 'phags pa la nye ring mi mnga'am zhes sgo phye bas de nyid du rdo skur gyur te/ chos slob bzhin pa'i phyag sor ker re bar lus pas spyan ras gzigs 'dzub ker mar grags/ de skabs nas rtsod pa rang zhi ba'o/ de nas na len+d+rar gnas der bzhugs nas chos mang du bstan 224)zla grags kyis mdzad pa'i sgra'i bstan bcos kun tu bzang po zhes bya ba tshigs bcad legs so gzigs pas rang gis mdzad pa'i sgra mdo sdebs mi legs par mkhyen nas/ 'gro don mi 'byung ngam snyam nas dpe khrom par bskyur bas/ rje btsun sgron mas/ khyod skyis 'di ni sems can la phan par 'gyur gyi/ zla grags kyis 'di ni mkhas pa'i nga rgyal gyis byas pas gzhan la phan thogs chung ngur 'gyur ro/ de'i phyir glegs bam nas phyungs shig ces lung bstan pa ltar blangs te/ khron pa de'i chu 'thung pa kyang shes rab chen por byung skad/ tsan+d+ra pa ni de nas da lta'i bar du dar rgyas shin tu che zhing*/ phyi nang thams cad slob par byed la/ kun tu bzang po ni mi ring bar nub te da lta dpe tsam yang yod par mi snang ngo*/ der bzo'i gnas brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ sgra dang*/ rtog ge dang*/ sman dpyad dang*/ sdebs 225)sbyor dang*/ zlos gar dang*/ mngon brjod dang*/ snyan dngags dang*/ skar rtsis la sogs pa'i bstan bcos mang du brtsams shing 'chad spel mdzad pa'i tshe/ 'phags ma sgron mas/ sa bcu pa dang zla ba sgron me dang*/ sdong pos brgyan pa dang ni laṅkar 'jug rgyal ba rnams kyi yum gyur klogs shig kyai sdeb sbyor ngan g.yo'i sbyor bas khyod la ci/ zhes gsungs pas phyi rol gyi rigs gnas nyung ngur btang nas/ rmad du byung ba'i mdo lnga po de nyin re zhal 'don dang gzhan la 'chad spel/

de lnga la don bsdu'i bstan bcos re yang mdzad/ 'dis snga phyir mdzad pa'i bstan bcos ni/ bstod pa brgya dang brgyad/ nang rig pa'i bstan bcos brgya dang brgyad/ phyi rol pa'i bstan bcos brgya dang brgyad/ bzo gnas brgya dang brgyad/ sgrol ma dang spyan ras gzigs gnyis kyi sgrub thabs brgya 226)rtsa re/ phra mo 'thor bu ba bzhi brgya sum rtsa gnyis rnams mdzad par grags/ de ltar sems can gyi don yun ring mdzad nas mthar po ta lar gshegs par bzhed nas/ 'dzam bu'i gling nas dha na shri'i gling du byon pa na/ sngon klu she ṣa la smad pas 'khon du bzungs nas rgya mtsho'i rlabs chen pos gru gzings zhig par brtsams/ rgya mtsho'i dbus nas sgra byung nas/ tsan+d+ra go mi phyungs shig zer/ sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas/ 'phags ma gtso 'khor lnga mkha' lding la chibs nas mdun gyi nam mkhar byon pas/ klu rnams 'jigs shing bskrag nas bros/ gru rta na shrir bde bar slebs so/ der dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten yang mchod cing sgrol ma dang spyan ras gzigs kyi lha khang brgya rtsa re bzhengs/ ri bo ta lar gshegs nas da lta yang sku lus ma spangs par bzhugs so/ 227)rgyal po seṅge lnga pa'i dus su mchog sde'i slob ma dul ba'i sde dang*/ ma gha dh+ra btsun pa grol sde dang yon tan 'od kyi slob ma mngon pa yon tan blo gros dang*/ slob dpon chos skyong dang*/ dbyug sde dang bcas pa rnams byon/ dul ba'i sde dang btsun pa rnam grol sde'i lo rgyus rgyas pa ma mthong ngo*/ mngon pa yon tan blo gros rig nas mtha' dag la mkhas shing mngon pa mdzod kyi 'brel bshad kyang byas/ dbu ma rtsa ba la blo brtan gyi rjes su 'brangs te legs ldan 'gog pa'i 'grel bar grags so/ slob dpon chos skyong ni/ slob dpon chos 'bangs las rab tu byung zhing 'dul ba nyan/ phyogs glang las sde snod yan lag dang bcas pa nyan te mkhas pa'i dbyug mdo sde chen po brgya rtsa zhal 'don mdzad pa/

'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po zhal gzigs nas rtag tu chos nyan pa/ zla grags kyi rjes su na 228)len+d+ra'i mkhan po yang mdzad/ mu stegs kyi rgol ba rnams khro bo dbyug sngon gyis bsdigs nas ngag gnon par byed pa zhig ste/ 'dis dbu ma bzhi brgya pa la rnam rig rgyu bkra ba'i 'grel pa yang mdzad pa sogs 'gro phan rgya che/ mthar bcud len gyi dngos grub sgrubs nas lha'i gnas su bzhud do/ zhes grags so/ de'i 'og tu na len+d+ra'i mkhan po rgyal ba'i lhas mdzad/ de'i slob ma zhi ba lha dang bi ru pa yin no/ bi ru pa ni/ na len+d+rar slob gnyer byed skabs/ lan gcig di bi ko ṭar phyin pas/ bud med gcig gis me tog ut+pal gcig dang mgron bu zhig gtad pa blangs phyin pas/ mi rnams mkha' 'gro mas rgyas btab pa snying re rje zer rgyu mtshan ci byas pas/ de bor dang zer bor bas/ lag pa la 'byar te 'bor ma thub/ de nas nang pa'i mkha' 'gro ma gcig dang 'phrad nas/ skyob dgos byas pas/ nged phyi 229)nang gnyis kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams me tog sprod pa su dbang bar byas zer/ thabs gzhan med dam byas pa na/ dpag tshad lnga'i pha rol tu phyin na thar te nyi ma dgong khar song bas mi sleb zer/ mgron khang zhig tu rdza ma kha sprub pa'i 'og tu bsdad stong pa nyid bsgoms so/ de nub de na yod pa'i mi rnams re re nas phra men gyi 'khrid kyang rgyas btab pa de ma yin par shes te thams cad rang gnas so sor bskyal/ bī ra pa ma mthong ba'i ngang la nam langs te rnams gyes so/ de nas bros te slar na len+d+rar phyin baṇ+ḍi tar gyur nas/ phra men ma rnams 'dul dgos dgongs slob dpon klu'i byang chub la gshin rje ched zhus nas bsgoms pas zhal mngon sum du mthong ste byon pas phra men rnams sngar rgyas btab pa de byung ngo zer 'jigs pa'i gzugs kyis za bar brtsams pa na/ gshin rje gshed 230)kyi dkyil 'khor du bzhengs pas/

de rnams brgyal zhing shi la khad par song ba de rnams dam la bzhag nas spyod pa la byon pa yin no/ zhi ba lha ni rgyal ba'i sras su 'khrungs/ sngon gyi las 'phro'i mthu chung ngu nas mnal lam du 'jam dpal zhal gzigs/ de nas rgyas srid du bsko ba'i nub mo khri thog tu 'jam dpal bzhugs nas/ bu gcig 'di ni nga yi stan yin te/ nga ni khyod kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin/ khyod dang nga nyid stanagacig la 'dug pa/ 'di ni rnam pa kun tu rigs ma yin/ zhes gsungs pa dang*/ sgrol mas kyang rang gi ma'i tshul gyis chu tshan spyi bor blugs nas rgyas srid ni dmyal ba'i chu tshan no/ zhes gsogs byung bas rgyal srid bzung du mi rung bar mkhyen nas bros nas song ngo*/ nags tshal zhig tu sleb pa na bud med gcig gis khrid de nags tshal gyi brag phug na rnal 'byor pa 'dug pa'i drung du 231)bskyal byung bar der gdam pa zhus nas bsgoms pas ting nge 'dzin dang ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa thob bo/ rnal 'byor pa de 'jam dpal dang bud med de sgrom ma yin par grags te/ de nas rtag tu 'jam dpal gyi zhal gzigs so/ de nas shar phyogs su byon pas rgyal po seṅge lnga pa'i 'khor byed dgos pa byung ste/ der bzo'i gnas sngon med pa rnams kyang dar bar byas/ rgyal srid kyang chos bzhin du skyong du bcug pas/ blon po gzhan rnams kyi phra dog byas te/ rgyal po la 'di ni g.yo can zhig ste ral gri yang shing las med byas pas/ yi dam lha'i phyag mtshan shing gi ral gri yod pa rgyal pos ston zer/ slob dpon gyis 'di bstan na lha nyid la gnod par 'gyur ro byas pas/ lhag par the tshom skyes te/ gnod kyang sla yi nges par ston cig zer/ 'o na spyan g.yas pa 232)khob la g.yon pa gzigs shig gsung*/ de ltar bstan pas ral gri'i 'od kyi rgyal po'i spyan g.yon pa lhungs so/ de nas grub thob yin par shes te bsnyen bkur ro/

de nas yul dbus su byon mkhan po rgyal ba'i lha las rab tu byung nas ming zhi ba lhar btags so/ der paṇ+ḍi ta rnams dang lhan gcig gnas nas chos thams cad thugs su chud de bslab pa kun las btus dang mdo kun las btus legs par brtsams/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal la chos gsan zhing*/ nyin mtshan du mnal ba ltar las/ phyi rol gzhan dor thos bsam bsgom gsum gang yang mi byed par bstan pas/ dge 'dun rnams kyis dad zas chud 'dza' bas 'di bskrad dgos pa las/ mdo 'don res byas na rang bud la 'gro zhes bgros nas/ mthar mod 'don res babs pa la/ thog mar zhal gyis 233)ma bzhes/ nan gyis 'chu ba la/ 'o na khri brtsegs shig 'don par bya 'o gsungs pas 'ga' zhig the tshom du gyur*/ phal cher dma' dbab pa'i don du yin pas/ khri mtho bar brtsegs pa la/ der 'dzegs nas/ sngar byung zhig 'don nam ma byung ba zhig 'don byas pas/ thams cad kyis tshod len pa'i phyir ma byung ba thon cig zer/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa gsungs te/ gang tshe dngos dang dngos med dag blo yi mdun na mi gnas pa/ ces pa'i tshig mtshams nas nam mkhar 'phur zhing gshegs nas/ sku lus mi snang yang gsung gi snang ba ma chad pa byung ste spyod 'jug rdzogs par gsungs so/ der paṇ+ḍi ta gzungs thob pa rnams kyis blo la bzungs bas/ kha che ba rnams kyis sho lo ka stong lhag pa cig byung*/ shar pa rnams 234)kyi sho lo ka bdun brgya las med pa/ mchod brjod dbu ma rtsa ba'i de bcug de yang bshags le dang sher le gnyis chad pa yin/ dbus pa rnams kyis mchod brjod dang rtsom par dam bca' med pa rjes sngags kyi dbang du rtses pa'i sho lo ka stong yod pa gcig byung bar/ der the tshom du gyur pas/ bod ltar na grong khyer dpal yon can na bzhugs zer na'ang*/ grong khyer ka liṅkar gshegs te bzhugs pa thos pas paṇ+ḍi ta gsum gyis der song ste/

gsum po de gang dag ces zhus pas/ yul dbus pa rnams kyi bzungs ba ltar yin gsungs so/ de nas lho phyogs kyi nang du phyi nang gnyis rtsod pa'i nus pa 'gran pa na/ nang pas ma nus pa'i sar byon/ der mu stegs kyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bris pa skad cig la rlung la bskur te mu stegs pa dang der dga' ba'i skye bo kun yang rlung drag pos khyer te chu bo zhig yod pa'i pha rol tu 'phangs/ nang pa rnams 235)la ci yang ma skyon/ de nas mu stegs kyi chos bsnubs nas nang pa'i chos lab tsud de dar ba byas yul der mu stegs phams pa'i yul zhes grags so/ gang ltar yang*/ lhag pa'i lha bsnyes na len+d+ra'i/ bkod pa phun tshogs rtsod pa bzlog yang mtshan can dang sprang po dang*/ rgyal po mu stegs btul ba dang*/ zhes ngo mtshar can gyi gtam bdun yin par 'dod do/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen ni/ kha che'i yul gyi rgyal po zhig gi zur bu byis pa chung ngu'i skabs khang ste du gnyal nas/ mas me tog mthur song bar bya rgod kyi khyer te na len+d+ra'i gan+dho la zhig gi rtse mor bzhag go/ paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyis de blangs te gsos nas cher skyes ba na blo rno bar gyur te dge slong sde snod 'dzin pa'i bar du gyur/ sgrol ma bsgrubs pas zhal gzigs shing longs spyod mi zad pa byung*/ thams cad sbyin par btang 236)bas nam zhig sbyin rgyu zad/ slong ba po mangs bas thag ring zhig tu byon skabs/ bram ze rgan mo mig long ba bus long khrid byas pa dang 'phrad/ gang 'gro dris pas/ thams cad mkhyeran pa'i bshes gnyen gyis sbyin pas thams cad mgu bar byed pa yod zer bas/ der slong la 'gro zer/ de nyid nga yin na yo byad thams cad zad pas 'dir 'ongs so byas pas/ de shin tu sdug bsngal gyis nyams thag go/ de la snying rje tshad med pa skyes te/ khyod bsdug bsngal bar ma byed cig ngas yo byad blangs nas 'ong ngo byas/

de'i tshe lta ba log pa'i slob dpon zhig yod pa des/ rgyal po sa ra ṇa zhes bya ba la/ mi brgya rtsa brgyad nyos nas sbyin sreg byas na/ de rnams kyi bsod nams dang dbang thang thams cad bdag nyid la 'byung zhing thar pa'i rgyu yang yin no byas par/ brgya dang bdun nyos te rnyed gcig ma rnyed pa'i skabs der slob dpon gyis der phyin nas mi nyo ba su yod 237)byas pa rgyal pos nyo zer/ rin du slob dpon gyi lus brjid dang mnyam pa'i gser gzhal byung ba bram zer long ba la sbyin nas mgu bar byas te byon pas/ mi de rnams na re/ gal te khyod la 'ongs na nged rnams thar ba yang srid pa las/ da ni da lta nyid du me la sreg go zhes shin tu sdug bsngal bar 'dug cing*/ de'i nub mo phyogs yangs pa gcig tu shing gi tshogs ri ltar spungs pa'i dbus su mi brgya rtsa brgyad po bcings te bzhag lta log gi slob dpon de cho ga byas/ shing thams cad me 'ur gyis 'bar ba'i tshe/ mi brgya rtsa bdun po de rnams cho nge 'don cing nyams thag par/ slob dpon snying rje mi zad pa skyes te/ 'phags ma sgrol ma la yus kyis gsol ba btab pas rje bzun ma mdun du byon te phyag las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ skye bo rnams kyi snang ngor phyogs gar na yang med par me 'bar ba kho 238)na'i thad du char gyi rgyun gnya' shing tsam byung me zhi nas mtsho rdzing du gyur/ rgyal po yang mtshan skyes te slob dpon la gus par mchod/ mi rnams kyang rang gnas su btang ngo*/ dus 'di tsam na/ grub chen ḍam̐ bi he ru ka dang*/ grub chen rdo rje dril bu pa yang byung*/ bi ru pas grub pa thob nas lo bcu tsam na/ ḍam̐ bi he ru kas dngos grub bsnyes/ de nas lo bcu tsam na dril bu pas bsnyes so/ de nas lo mang tsam song ba na spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa shin tu dar yang*/ thogs med sku ched dang*/ phyogs kyi glang po bzhugs pa tsam la ltos na/

shar phyogs dang lho phyogs kyi rgyud kun tu mu stegs 'phel zhing*/ sangs rgyas pa 'grib pa'i tshul/ mu stegs kyi rtsod pa'i khyu mchog tu gyur pa gzhon nu rol pa dang*/ gzig ma sgra sgrog ces pa gnyis byung ste/ sangs rgyas bskyangs dang*/ legs ldan dang*/ chos 'bangs dang*/ phyogs glang gi slob ma 239)rnams dang*/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun mang po dag gi longs spyod dang mnga' thang 'phrogs nas nyams smad par byas de dus slob dpon chos skyong gi slob ma de wa shra ma zhes bya bas zla grags 'gog par brtsams nas dbu ma'i 'grel pa dkar po rnams par 'char ba byas/ mu stegs 'ga' zhig dang rtsod par yang rgyal te/ rgyal po sa la wa han zhes pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan par bcug des lha khang dang mchod rten mang du bzhengs/ chos gzhi yang ci rigs gtsugs par grags slob dpon dbyig gnyen bzhugs pa yan chad na sde pa bco brgyad po yang cha tshang tsam yod la/ de nas bar skabs de rnams su rtsod pa'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ rtes dbang gis nus pa sna tshogs byung ste/ dge 'dun phal chen pa las/ shar gyi ri bo pa dang*/ nub kyi ri bo pa dang*/ gangs rir gnas pa gsum stongs/ thams cad yod smra nas/ 'od srungs pa dang rnam par phye ste smra ba gnyis stongs 240)gnas brtan pa las/ gtsug lag khang chen pa dang*/ mang bkur ba las bsrung ba pa'i sde pa stongs te/ lhag ma rnams dar bar yod do/ de la nyan thogs rnams kyi sgrub pa'i bstan pa ni lo lnga brgya nas nyams pa ltar gyur pa yin mod/ de'i grub mtha'i phyogs 'dzin pa ni da lta'i bar du yod pas so/ dpal ldan chos kyi grags pa ni/ lho phyogs rgyal dbang gtsug gi nor bu zhes bya bar 'khrungs ces sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams gsungs la/ tri ma la'i yul yin pa phyi nang kun la grags pas sngon dus de la rgyal dbang gtsug nor du grags skad/ 'khrungs pa'i dus ni rgyal po seṅge lnga pa dang*/

gsal ba sogs kyi dus yin par sngon yab bral ze'i rigs kyi mu stegs kun tu rgyu ro3 nan+da ces bya ba'i bur skyes te/ chung ngu nas blo gros shin tu sgrin pas/ bzo gnas dang*/ rig byed yan lag dang bcas pa dang*/ sman dpyad dang*/ brda 241)sprod pa dang*/ mu stegs can gyi grub pa'i mtha' ma lus pa la shin tu sbyangs pas mu stegs kyi grub mtha' la mkhas par gyur nas/ bram ze rnams kyis mngags 'os lhag par bstod pa'i skabs shig na/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung rabs 'ga' re gzigs pas rang gi ston pa dang grub mtha' rnams skyon du gzigs/ sangs rgyas dang dam pa'i chos la mos pa skyes te/ nang pa'i dge bsnyen gyi cha lugs su bsgyur bas/ bram ze rnams kyis rgyu mtshan bris pa na/ sangs rgyas kyi bsngags pa brjod pas de rnams kyi gnas nas bskrad do/ de nas yul dbus su byon slob dpon chos skyong las rab tu byung nas sde snod gsum la mkhas par byas/ mdo sde gzungs sngags bsdoms pa lnga brgya tsam thugs nas 'don/ rtog ge'i bstan bcos gzhan gyis blos ma khengs dbyug sde la tshad ma kun las btus pa tshar cig 242)nyan pas dbyug sde nyid dang mnyam par gyur/ lan gnyis nyan pas phyogs glang dang mnyam par gyur/ gsum nyan pa/ dbyug sdes kyang phyogs kyi glang po'i dgongs pa 'ga' zhig nor bar mkhyen te/ slob dpon nyid la bzlas pas shin tu dgyes te/ khyod ni phyogs kyi glang po dang mnyam ste grub mtha' nor ba thams cad srun phyungs la/ tshad ma kun las btus la 'grel pa yang gyis shig ces slob dpon las gnang ba thob bo/ slob dpon gyi drung du gsang sngags zhus nas bsgoms pas he ru kas zhal mngon sum du bstan te/ ci 'dod gsungs/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba 'tshal lo/ zhus pas ha ha hūṃ gsungs nas de nyid du mi snang bar gyur ro/ de nas mu stegs kyi grub mtha'i gsang tshig bslab par bzhed nas/

khol po'i cha lugs su brdzus te lho phyogs kyi rgyud du byon/ su mkhas dris pas/ gzhon nu rol rtsed la 'gran gyi zla med 243)zer/ der phyin pa na kho mnga' thang che ste/ phyi nang gi las bran pho lnga bcu dang bran mo lnga bcus byed pa de slob dpon gcig bus grub par byas pa na/ gzhon nu rol rtsid chung mar bcas pa shin tu dga'o/ khyod cing 'dod zer bar/ grub mtha' nyan par 'tshal lo byas pas/ rig pa mtha' dag bstan/ gsang tshig bu dang chung ma ma gtogs gzhan la mi ston pa dga' zhig yod pa rnams kyang las kyi bya bas bu dang chung ma mgu bar byas te/ de rnams la dris pas shes so/ der grub mtha'i gnad don ji ltar 'gog pa'i tshul rnams kyang legs par shes pa na/ bram ze nor la srid pas nor ma sbyin na nyer par 'gyur ro snyams nas/ de na gnas pa'i gnod sbyin zhig la gser gyi dong rtse bdun stong blangs nas gzhon nu rol pa la sbyin/ rang gi sla dngul pa ṇa lnga brgya yod 244)pa bram ze rnams la ston mo cher byas te/ de nub bros nas byon no/ kā ka ku ha zhes bya ba'i tshong 'dus chen po pho brang dang bcas yod pa la/ 'dir rtsod par 'dod pa su yod ces sgro yig btab ste bsdad pas/ gzeg zan gyi grub mtha' 'dzin pa bram ze kan gu dang*/ gzhan yag lta ba drug gi grub mtha' 'dzin pa lnga brgya tsam 'dus byung nas/ zla ba gsum du rtsad pas/ thams cad srun phyungs te sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bcug rgyal pos kyang de dge nang na bram ze longs spyod dang ldan pa lnga bcu tsam gyis nang pa'i chos gzhi ste 'dzugs su bcug gtam de gzhon nu rol pas thos nas shin tu khros te/ rang nyid bram ze lnga brgya dang bcas rtsod par 'ongs/ gal te kho bo rgyal na chos kyi grags pa gsod cig chos kyi grags pa rgyal na nga gsod cig ces rgyal po la bsgo ba las/ slob dpojan gyis gal te gzhon nu rol pa rgyal na rgyal pos shes/

gal te bdag rgyal na 245)gzhon nu rol pa gsad du mi 'tshal te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gzhugs par bya'o gsungs/ der bstan pa dpang du gtsugs nas rtsad pas/ gzhon nu rol pa'i thun mongs ma yin pa'i dam bca' lnga brgya yod pa thams cad re re nas rig pa'i rnam grangs brgya brgyas srun phyungs/ der gzhon nu rol pas kyang nang pa mchod par byas/ bram ze lnga brgya yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dad de rab tu byung ba byas/ gzhan yang mu stegs kyi rtsod zla yod do cog cher bcad par mdzad do/ slar yang dra ba mi'i yul du byon nas/ yul 'di na rtsod par 'dod pa su yod ces dris sgrags pas/ mu stegs phal cher bros/ 'ga' zhig gis rtsod par mi nus par mkhas bslangs so/ de'i tshe dpal na len+d+rar ga ra ā tsar+yas rtsod pa byed do zhes 'phrin brdzangs so/ de rnams kyis kyang sang phod bya'o zhes phyi dus btab/ chos kyi grags pa 246)lho phyogs nas spyan drangs so/ de nas rtsod pa'i dus su babs pa na/ sangs rgyas pa rnams dang*/ bram zer dang mu stegs mtha' dag rgyal po rab gsal gyi ka ra ṇā sir bsdus te/ rgyal po dpang po'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ sam ga ra ā tsar+ya dang chos kyi grags pa rtsod pa phyogs pa na sam ga ra na re/ gal te nged rgyal ba na khyed gaṅgā la 'chong ngo*/ mu stegs la 'dam kha gyis/ ci ste khyed rgyal na de gaṅga la 'chongs te 'chi bar byed do zer nas brtsad pas/ chos kyi grags pa sam ga ra yang nas yang du pham par byas te/ mthar cang mi smra ba'i gnas la bkod/ de nas sam ga ra gaṅgā la 'chi bar tsom pa slob dpon gyis bzlog kyang ma nyan par/ kho rang gi slob ma bha ṭa ā tsar+ya la khyod kyis rtsod pa gyis la/ mgo bres 'di las rgyal bar gyis shig ma rgyal yang rung*/ nga khyod kyi bur skye ba blangs nas 'di rnams phye mar 'thag par bya'o zer nas gaṅgār 247)'chong nas shi'o/

de'i slob ma mang tsam sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la tsud/ lhag ma rnams thag ring bor bros so/ de'i phyi lo nyid bha dra ā tsar+ya'i bus skye ba blangs/ bha dra ā tsar+yas kyang lo gsum du lha mnyes par byas/ yang lo gsum du nang pa'i grub mtha' 'gog byed kyi rig pa bsams/ lo bdun pa la sngar bzhin brtan pa dpang du gtsugs nas brtsad pas/ sngar bzhin phams nas gaṅga la 'chong ste shi'o/ der de nyid kyi bu thu bapa bha dra ā tsar+ya gnyis pa dang*/ sam ga ra ā tsar+ya'i skye ba dang*/ rang gi grub mtha' la zhen pa rnams shar phyogs thag ring por bros so/ bram ze lnga brgya tsam ni bstan pa la rab tu byung*/ lnga brgya tsam dkon mchog la skyabs su song*/ de las gzhan ma bha dha'i bram ze gang ba zhes bya ba dang*/ btsom brlag tu bram ze gang ba bzang po zhes bya ba gnyis kyang btul te/ de gnyis 248)kyi so so'i yul du nang pa'i chos gzhi lnga bcu re gtsugs so/ der snyan pa'i grags pas sa steng thams cad la khyab bo/ de nas ma gha dha dang nye ba drang srong ma tam ga'i gnas su yun ring du bzhugs te rigs sngags mang po grub par mdzad/ de nas 'begs byed kyi ri bo'i khongs na/ rgyal po me tog gi bu me tog kun ru rgyas pa zhes bya ba yod de/ grong 'bum phrag sum cu la dbang bsgyur ba longs spyod kyi khyad par ni lha dang mtshungs so zhes grags pa cig yod pa'i sar ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa las/ mthar gyi rgyal po'i pho brang du byon pa na/ rgyal pos su yin dris pas/ shes rab can ni phyogs kyi glang po ste/ tsan+d+ra go mi brjod pa rnam par dag snyan dngags dpa' bo las byung sdebs sbyor mkhas/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba nga min su/ zhes gsungs pa na/ chos kyi grags pa yin nam zhes dris pas/ 'jig rten na de ltar bdag dgos gsungs 249)rgyal po des kyang gtsug lag khang mang du bzhengs shing der chos kyi grags pa bzhugs su gsol/

tshad ma sne bdun gyi bstan bcos kyang brtsams nas/ gal te chos kyi grags pa yi/ smra ba'i nyi ma nub pa na/ chos rnams gnyid log yang na shi chos ma yin rnams da gdod longs/ zhes ched du brjod pa rgyal po'i sgo khang du yig ger bris so/ yul der dge slong khri phrag snyed byung zhing chos gzhi yang lnga bcu tsam gtsugs/ de nas mtha' 'khob kyi yul gu dzir thar byon nas mu stegs mang po sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la tsud/ go ta pū li zhes bya ba'i lha khang bzhengs/ yul der mu stegs shin tu mang ba las/ de rnams kyi slob dpon gyi brang khang la me btang ste phyogs thams cad mes tshig par gyur pa na/ lhag pa'i lha dang gsang sngags rjes su dran pas nam mkha'i lam la bgrod nas phyogs de nas dpag 250)tshad gcig tsam gyi yul de nyid kyi rgyal po'i pho brang dang nye bar byon/ thams cad ngo mtshar du 'dzin par gyur ro/ grub thob brgya bcu'i bstod par yang rgol ba tshar gcod mkha' la gshegs/ ces pa yang gtam rgyud 'di la brten par mngon no/ de'i tshe sa ga ra ā tsar+ya slar yang skye ba blangs pa de nyid snga ma las kyang ches shin tu blo rno zhing*/ rtsod pa la mkhas pa/ bum pa'i steng du lhas lus rdzogs par ston pa gcig byung dpal chos kyi grogs pa la rtsod par 'dod de/ wa ra ṇā sir 'ongs nas rgyal po ma hā pya ni la bsgos shing*/ phyogs thams cad du dril bsgrags/ der slob dpon lho phyogs nas spyan drangs te/ bram ze'i skye bo stong phrag lnga tsam dang*/ rgyal po la sogs pa skye bo dpag tu med pa yang 'dus sngon bzhin bstan pa dpang du gtsugs pa las/ shin tu tshar gcad pas/ yang gaṅgā la 'chongs te shi'o/ de dag gi rjes 'brangs 251)mang po la rab tu byung la la dge bsnyen la btsud do/ de'i tse kha che'i slob dpon gsum byung bar drang po'i sems kyi grub mtha' la brgal brtag mang du byas pas nang pa shin tu dad de/

skyabs 'gro dang bslab pa blangs grub mtha' nyan nas tshad ma ste bdun la shin tu mkhas par gyur nas byang phyogs kha che'i yul du song nas chos kyi grags pa'i lugs kyi rtog ge dar bar byas so/ slar yang lho phyogs kyi rgyud du byon te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ bstan pa'i 'gal rkyen rnams rtsod pas tshar bcad/ rgyal po dang blon po la sogs pa chos kyi sgo nas dbang du bsdus/ dge 'dun gyi sde dang chos gzhi thug med du dar bar mdzad/ slob dpon nyid kyis bzhengs pa'i lha khang yang brgya tsa tsam yod cing*/ gzhan la bskul te bzhengs pa ni bgrangs ba las 'das/ slob dpon 'di yongs su bskul te 252)bstan pa la bcug pa'i dge slong dang ge bsnyen yan chad sdoms na 'bum du nye ba tsam yod par grags na'ang*/ phal cher mkhan slob gzhan la gtad pa kho na yin zhing*/ chos kyi 'brel ba'i slob mas ni sa steng thams cad khyab kyang*/ phyi bzhin rjes su 'brangs ba ni lnga las lhag pa yongs su ma bzung ngo zhes grags so/ sku tshe tha ma'i tshe yang sngar gyi sam ga ra ā tsar+ya de nyid bha dra ā tsar+ya phyi ma'i bur skye ba blangs ste sngon las kyang blo gros kyi stobs lhag par che ba/ rang gi lha mdun du 'ongs te mngon sum du rig pa slob pa/ res 'ga' de'i lus la zhugs nas kyang sngon med pa'i rig pa brjod pa byung ba/ su rgyal grub mtha' la 'jug par byas nas brtsad pas/ dpal chos kyi grags rgyal ba byung bas/ de nyid sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bcug nas/ lho phyogs kyi rgyud du bram ze dge bsnyen tshangs spyod la gnas 253)pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa mchod par byed pa byung ngo zhes grags shing*/ de nas dus kyi mthar yul ka ra gtsug lag khang bzhengs shing skye bo mang po chos la bkod nas sku 'das/ gdung dur khrod du zhugs la zhen pas me tog char babs shing*/ phyogs thams cad dri bzang po dang rol mos khyab pa zhag bdun gyi bar du byung*/

gdung thams cad 'ching bu 'dra ba'i rdo'i gong bu gcig tu 'dril ba las rgyus pa'i rnam pa ye med de lta yang dus ston gyi mchod pa byed do/ slob dpon 'di dang bod kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po dus mnyam mo zhes grags pa bzhin don la gnas par mngon no/ slob dpon 'dis sde bdun brtsams nas paṇ+ḍi ta phal cher gyis ma go/ 'ga' zhig go ba byung kyang phra dog gi dbang gis mi legs so byas/ khyi'i mjug ma la btags pas/ khyi ni lam srang kun tu rgyu ba 254)de bzhin du nga'i bstan bcos kyang phyogs kun tu khyab par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs shing*/ gzhung gi mgor/ skye bo phal cher phal ma chags shing sogs sho lo ka gcig bcug pa dang*/ phyis slob dpon lha dbang blo dang*/ shākya blo la sde bdun legs par bshad de/ rang 'grel gyi 'gros lha dbang blo la brtsams par bskos/ lan gcig brtsams te gzigs phul bas chus bkrus/ yang brtsams pa mes bsregs te slar yang brtsams te/ phal cher skal ba med nyid dang*/ dus la'ang sdod pa med pa'i phyir/ goms pa'i phyir ni mdor bsdus nas bka' 'grel 'di ni 'dir byas so/ zhes bris te phul bas/ 'phros dang tshig zur gyis mtshon pa'i gnad don rnams ma byung ba 'dug cing tshig gi dngos bstan gyi don rnams 'byung 'dug gsungs nas bzhag nga'i rig pa 'di dpyis phyin pa sus kyang mi shes pa 'dug dgongs 255)nas rnam 'grel gyi mjug tu/ rgya mtsho la ni chu bo bzhin du rang gi lus la thim zhing nub pa nyid du 'gyur/ zhes pa'i tshig bcad bcug go/ de ltar na rgyan drug pa de dag las/ klu sgrub thogs med/ phyogs glang gsum ni gzhung byed pa po yin la/ 'phags pa lha/ dbyig gnyen/ chos kyi grags pa gsum ni 'grel byed yin no/ de rnams so so'i dus skabs la ltos te in+d+ra bhū ti bar pa dang*/ ku ku rā dza dang*/ slob dpon mtsho skyes rdo rje dang*/

lā li ta badz+ra rnams 'ol spyi tsam du dus mnyam mo/ 'di skabs kyi mtsho skyes rdo rje ni bar pa de yin no/ la li ta badz+ra ni na len+d+ra'i paṇ+ḍi ta gcig yin la/ rnam snang rgyu dra'i rgyud la brten te 'jam 256)dpal la yi dam du byas nas sgrub pa mdzad pas lo nyi shu tsam na zhal gzigs te rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ o rgyan gyi gnas chos kyi mdzod nas gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud spyan drongs shig pa'i lung bstan byung ba ltar/ o rgyan gyi gnas dharma gañdza zhes bya ba nas/ ma 'ongs pa'i sems can la phan pa'i don du gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud spyan 'dren no zhes mkha' 'gro ma rnam la zhus par/ zhag bdun du blo la ji ltar gsum pa dang*/ rtog pa bdun pa dang*/ gzhan yang gzungs dang rgyud dang*/ rtog pa'i rim pa 'thor bu ba mang po dang bcas pa thugs su chud/ 'dzam bu'i gling du dar bar mdzad do/ gzhan yang mu stegs pham pa dang*/ lha khang bzhengs pa sogs mdzad pa mtha' yas/ gshin 257)rje gshed kyi rigs sngags kyis/ nang pa la shin tu gnod pa'i klu dang bstan par sdang pa'i mu stegs dang*/ mi ma yin gdug pa can dang*/ stag gzig sogs mang po mngon spyod kyi 'phris kyis 'gro don mdzad nas mthar 'ja' lus su gshegs so/ de'i slob ma lī la badz+ra gyis slob dpon gyi gsung ngag yig ger bkod pas bshin rje gshed 'byung ba dang zhi khro rnam rol sogs lī la badz+ra chen pos mdzad par byed do/ lwa wa pa dang*/ lā li badz+ra dang*/ in+d+ra bhū ti rnams kyis cho 'phrul 'gran pa'i lo rgyus yod kyang ma bris/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug gi rgyu pa 'di gshin rje gshed nyid dang mi gnyis pa yin pas gshed dmar gyi rgyud spyan drangs shing*/ sgrub thabs dang man ngag yi ger bkod/ de'i sbalo ma sngo ma bhi he ru kas/ ku ru kul le'i rtogs pa dang ya ra le gnyis spyan drangs/ rgyud don mngon

258)shes kyis mkhyen cing*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang bka' bgros pa las dgyes rdor gyi rgyud kyi snying po blangs nas/ bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs dang lhan cig skyes sgrub la sogs pa gzhung du ma mdzad cing slob ma la dbang bskur ro/ de nas slob dpon lā wa bapa dang mtsho skyes gnyis kyi dgyes rdor gyi rgyud spyan drangs nas bstan bcos mdzad pas sgrub thabs mtsho skyes rdo rje zhes grags so/ chos kyi grag pa sku 'das tsam na/ rgyal po bhat+thā re dang go tsan+d+ra byung*/ rgyal po de gnyis grub thob dza lan+dha ri pa dang*/ slob dpon nag po spyod pas btul nas grub pa thob tshul 'dug go/ de skabs thags mkhan gyi bya bas 'tsho ba'i grub thob ran+te pa yang byung*/ yul pa rnams ma mo mchod pa'i phyir ra skyes stong phrag mang po gsod par brtsams pa na/ slob dpon des rwa rnams la sngags bzlas pas/ thams cad kyang lce spyang gi gzugs 259)su gyur/ ma mos gzugs bstan par/ mngar gsum gyis mchod pas tshim par bgos pas da lta'i bar du yang de ltar byed do/ de rjes grub thob rgyal po lhan skyes rol pa dang*/ slob dpon du ba lha byung*/ des tshad ma sde bdun la 'grel pa byas/ mdo sde 'dzin pa shu bha mi rta dang*/ tshul khrims bskyangs dang*/ shan+ti so ma la sogs byung*/ rnam rig gi grub mtha' rtsa bar bzung*/ mdo sde dang 'dul ba yang dar bar byas so/ slob dpon dpal sbas rang gi lo rgyus zhig pa ma mthong yang de'i slob ma slob dpon ye shes snying po ni/ legs ldan gyi bsrol 'dzin dbu ma pa chen por grags pa yin te/ spyan ras gzigs sgrub nas yid bzhin nor bu'i 'khor los bsgyur ba zhal gzigs/ mngon shes dang ldan pa gcig byung*/ mdo sde du ma thugs nas 'don pa mu stegs rnams pham par mdzad pa yin no/ 260)dge bsnyen btsun pa ngo bo nyid med pa ni/

theg pa chen por rigs sad cing 'jam dpal gyi zhal gzigs/ mdo sde lnga cu tsam thugs nas 'don pa 'khor dge bsnyen stong phrag dang bcas pa/ 'khor rnams la dug sbrul gyi gnod pa byung ba sgrol ma'i rigs sngags kyis me tog gtor bas khong du med pa rnams kyang phyir phyung ste thams cad bde bar grol lo/ dus skabs 'di tsam na dus dbang gis mkhas pa nyung ba dang*/ mu stegs kyi rgol ba lhag par mangs bas/ nang pa'i rgol ba rnams sems 'tshab 'tshab mor gnas pa gcig yod pa na/ paṇ+ḍi ta bi ha ra zhes bya ba zhig yod pa des/ nang par rgol ba'i mu stegs mang po dang rtsod par khas blangs kyang*/ thub bam mi thub bam snyam pa'i the tshom ma yod pa las/ bud med rgan mo zhig byung nas/ tsher ma lta bu'i cod pan mgo bor gyon te rtsod gcig rgyal bar 'gyur ro zer/ 261)de bzhin byas pas/ der rgyal zhing*/ gzhan du yang rgyal ba byung nas/ de phyin chad nas paṇ+ḍi ta rnams zhwa rtse rings gyon pa rim gyas dar ro/ de nas le kha ra shing 'phel gyi nags tshal dang nye ba zhig na/ rgyal rigs kyi bu mo gzugs byad legs pa zhig shing gi lha dang 'dus pa las/ nam zhig na khyi'u mtshan dang ldan pa zhig btsas/ cher gyur nas lha mo tsan+d+ra li'i sgom lugs zhus te sgrub pas rmi lam du zhal bstan te/ rgyal srid thob par gsol btab pas/ khyod shar phyogs su song shig dang thob par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan te/ de'i tshe bhaṅga la'i yul du rgyal po med par mang zhing song*/ yul mi rnams sdug bsngal bar gyur pas/ gtso bo gtso bo rnams 'dus gros byas te/ rgyal po zhig bskos pa las/ de na klu mo mthu che ba gdug rtsub can zhig yod 262)pa des bskos pa'i nub mo zos so/ der res kyis bskos kyin snga dro bskos pa de nub zos par skya rengs shar ba tsam na phung po 'don no/ lha mo tsan+d+ra grub pa des khyim zhig tu phyin pa de rnams sdug bsngal gyis non pa la/

rgyu mtshan dris pas/ nang par de'i bu la rgyal po'i res 'babs zer/ gla byin na ngas tshab bya'o byas pas shin tu dga' ste/ gla yang blangs/ nang par rgyal sar bskos/ de'i na phyed na klu mo de srin mo'i gzugs su bsgyur sngar bzhin za bar 'ongs pa la/ yi dam gyi phyag mtshan brdzun pas klu mo rang shi'o/ tho rang phung po dbyung mkhan rnams byung mal/ ma shin bar mthong nas thams cad ya mtshan du gyur nas rgyal srid la bskos te/ sku tshe'i stod la bhaṅga lar dbang bsgyur smad ya dbang du bsdus te/ o tat+na pu ri dang nye bar nā len dra zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang zhig kyang bzhengs/ yul de nyid du dge 'dun gyi sde 263)mang du gtsug nas bstan pa mchod par byas so/ rgyal srid lo zhe lnga byas/ rgyal po 'di'i rings la zhi ba 'od dang*/ bsod nams grags kyi slob ma shākya 'od kyi kha che'i yul du 'gro don mdzad/ de'i yul du dha na shri la chen po dang*/ khyad par bshes gnyen dang*/ shes rab go cha dang*/ 'dul 'dzin slob dpon dpa' bo rnams byung*/ shar phyogs su slob dpon ye shes snying po yod thog sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs ye shes snying po/ zhi ba 'tsho rnams kyis dbu ma'i lugs srol 'dzin/ de rjes nub phyogs gats+tsha'i yul du bi bha ra ṭ+ṭa ces bya ba'i rgyal po byung*/ de'i dus su bi ru pa chung ba byung*/ rgyal po da nang pa la mos kyang blon po rnams phyis pa la mos pas/ der lha khang phyi nang gnyis ka'i lha'i rdo sku mi tshad tsam mang po bzhengs/ phyi nang gi lha khang tha dad byed byas pas blon po rnams kyis gcig tu bkod de/ der rab 265) ............ 265)gnas la mkhas pa gcig dgos par/ gzhan med/ nang pa'i dge bsnyen zhig la yon tan de 'dug pa mthong ste/ des gyis byas pa/ mu stegs pa'i sgrub g.yog mi byed zer/ de na re/ khyod mu stegs pa la skyabs su 'gro ni mi dgos/ longs spyod mi zad pa 'byung bas chos dar ba byas chog mod zer/ 'o na slob dpon la zhus nas 'ong gi byas nas/ zhus pas ga sna ste/ de'i sgrub g.yog byas/ ro langs lce phyir g.yug pa lan gsum byed/ dang po zin na dngos grub chen po/ gnyis pa 'bring*/ gsum pa la chung ngu 'grub/ lan gsum pa la ma zin na/ dang por 'o skol gnyis za/ de nas yul khams thams cad stongs pa tsam du 'gro zer/ dge bsnyen des dang po gnyis la ma zin/ de nas ro langs dang kha sprad de bsdad pas/ gsum pa la so btab pas zin/ de 266)nas lce ral grir gyur/ lus gser du song ngo*/ dge bsnyen gyis ral gri thogs te bskor nas nam mkha' la 'phags pa na/ mu stegs pa na re/ ngas ral gri'i don du bsgrub pa yin pas ril gri nga la mthong zer/ ngas ltad mo zhig ltas la 'ong gi byas nas ri rab gyi rtse mor phyin/ gling bzhi gling phran dang bcas pa yud kyi bskor nas/ ral gri kho rang la gtad pas/ lus gser du song ba 'di khyod rang gis/ rus pa la ma thub par sha'i thad nas chod/ chang rim dang smad tshong ma'i don sogs log pa la ma song ba gyis/ rang 'tsho ba dang dge ba'i las la spyad na de ring bcad pa'i shul do shul do nub gang ste zad mi shes pa yin no zer/ kho rang ral gri thogs nas lha yul du song ngo*/ dge bsnyen des ro langs kyi gser la brten nas/ o tan+ta pu ri'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ o tan+ta 'phur byed kyi don yin la/ nam 267)mkhar phyin nas ri rab gling bzhi dngos su mthong ba'i bkod pa ltar bzhengs/ de bzhengs pa'i rgyu dang der gnyug mar gnas pa'i dge slong lnga brgya dang*/ dge bsnyen lnga brgya'i 'tsho ba'ang sbyar/

rang ma shi'i bar kho rang gis chos gzhi gteg 'da'/ba'i tshe gser lhag ma 'ongs pa'i sems can gyi don du gter du sbas/ chos gzhi rgya chen po de wa pā la gtad par grags/ de klu'i bu yin par grags te/ rgyal po 'di'i yab rgyal po go bo pā la yin la/ de'i btsun mos bram ze rigs sngags grub pa zhig la rgyal po dbang du byed pa'i rig sngags zhus pas/ sman la sngags btab kha zas dang sbyar rgyas btab rgyal po la drongs shig byas nas bran mo la bskur bas rdzas chu la lhungs chus khyer te klu'i gnas su sleb pa na/ klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho skyong zhes byas bas zos pas/ de dbang 268)du gyur te/ rgyal po'i gzugs kyis 'ongs nas btsun mo dang 'phrad sbrum par gyur pas nam zhig khyi'u btsas te lha mchod pa'i tshe sbrul mgo rong gis byung bas/ klu'i rgyal po'i bur shes nas bskyed bsrengs/ rgyal po go bo pā la 'das nas rgyal po de wa pā la des srid byas/ gong ma las kyang mnga' thang tshe ste/ shar phyogs zha ren+d+ra mnga' 'og tu 'dus/ gtsug lag khang khyad 'phags zhig rtsig par bzhed nas so ma pu re bzhengs/ 'di la bod kyi lo rgyus phal che na chos skyong la mar me phul nas gsol ba btab kong bu gang du khyer ba der rtsig go snyam pa na chos skyong gi sprul pa bya rog zhig byung nas kong bu mtshor bskyur bas yid chad pa na klu'i rgyal po sbrul mgo lnga pa byung ste nga khyod kyi pha yin mtsho skabs nas rtsig par gzhug go byas pa ltar mtsho skams pa'i shul du rtsig zer ba/ de ni kha che'i 269)yul gyi rgya mtsho sbas pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i lo rgyus 'dir sbyar bar zad do zhes jo nang rje btsun ta ra nā thas gsung*/ rgyal po 'dis mu stegs rnams pham par bya ba'i ched du dmag bsdus nas gnas pa na nag po chen pos bye ma'i phung po 'di bsal ba'i 'og na mu stegs kyi lha khang yod de 'jig par 'dod na mtha' dmag gis skor la rol mo gyis shig zer/

de ltar byas pas/ bye ma'i phung po'i 'og nas rdo'i lha khang ngo mtshar can zhig thon/ dpal tshang gsum gyi gtsug lag khang du ming gtags so/ lo rgyus kha gcig na/ de ltar byas pas bye ma'i 'og nas nyan thos 'gog pa'ang byung cho 'phrul bstan nas mya ngan las 'das/ mu stegs kyi gtsug lag khang dang gnas gzhi bzhi bcu tsam rang zhig par song ngo zer bar yang snang*/ rgyal po 270)'di'i ring la nag po spyod pa chung ba bya no/ des ni bde mchog sgom pas mkha' 'gro mas lung bstan nas/ kā ma ru'i lha mo'i gnas na dngos grub kyis rdzas yod longs shig zer/ der phyin pas za ma tog cig rnyed/ kha phye lab ḍā ma ru dra ba can zhig byung*/ de lag tu thogs pa tsam gyis rkang pa sa la mi reg cing*/ drag tu dkrol na grub pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo lnga brgya tsam gang nas cha med par 'ongs nas de'i 'khor byed pa byung ste yun ring por 'gro don mdzad do/ 'di skabs slob dpon shākya 'od kyi slob ma shākya bshes gnyen dang*/ pya na re mche ba'i sde dang*/ ye shes zla ba dang*/ rdo rje mtshon cha dang*/ 'jam dpal grags pa dang*/ ye shes byin dang*/ lho phyogs kyi du btsun pa spyan ras gzigs brtul zhugs grub pa rnams dang*/ slob dpon seng ge bzang po yang rgyal po 'di'i dus paṇ+ḍi tar gyur/ de nas rgyal po tā pa pā las rgyalas srid 271)lo bcu gnyis byas skabs/ o rgyan gyi slob dpon sgeg pa rdo rjes dpal na len+d+rar lo bcu'i bar du bzhugs/ de la slob dpon sgeg rdor ni/ o rgyan gyi gnas su rab tu byung zhing grub mtha' rnams dbu ma pa rig pa'i gnas thams cad la mkhas pa'i mthar phyin/ o rgyan gyi gling phran ma dhī ma zhes bya bar 'jam dpal gyi sgrub pa mdzad pa bris sku'i zhal las 'od zer chen po byung ste gling de yun ring du snang bar byas/ dus der log par lta ba 'ga' zhig la nang pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta'i dbang po lnga sgrub rdzas la dgos pa byung*/

slob dpon dkrong du 'ongs pas glang po dang rta dang bu mo khyi'u sogs sna tshogs kyi gzugs su bsgyur bas ngo ma shes par phyin log pas/ sna tshogs gzugs can zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ de la sogs re ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa mtha' yas/ mthar 'da' lus rdo rje'i sku bsnyes so/ 272)de'i rjes rgyal po dharma pā las rgyal srid lo drug cu rtsa bzhi byas skabs su/ ye shes zhabs bla mar brten/ gsang 'dus dang phar phyin shes pa paṇ+ḍi ta kun gyi gral mgor 'jog pa sogs de gnyis la gus pa cher mdzad/ rgyal po 'dis spyin chos gzhi lnga bcu tsam gtsugs pa las/ sher phyin 'chad pa'i chos gzhi sum cu so lnga yod/ dpal bi kra ma la shrī la'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs te/ de yang ma gha dha'i byang ngos chu bo gaṅga'i 'gram ri de'u zhig gi rtsi la yod cig dbus su byang chub chen po'i sku tshad kyi lha khang*/ mtha' bskor du gsang sngags nang gi lha khang chung ba lnga bcu nga gsum/ lha khang dkyus ma lnga bcu nga bzhi ste lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad yod pa phyi lcags ris bskor ba bzhengs paṇ+ḍi ta brgya rtsa brgyad/ gtor ma'i slob dpon/ rab gnas slob dpon/ sbyin bsreg slob dpon/ byi ba srung ba/ phun ron bsrung ba dang*/ lha 'bangs kyi 273)gnyer byed pa brgya dang bcu gcig la zas gos 'tsho ba'i khyad par 'gran du med par sbyar/ zla dus su chos nyan po po dang bcas pa thams cad la stag res 'khor gyi ston mo dang 'bul ba bzang po re yang mdzad/ rags rtses tsam du byas na rgyal po 'di dang bod kyi rgyal po khri srong lde btsan dus mnyam du bshad/ 'di'i dus su sangs rgyas gsang ba dang*/ sangs rgyas zhi ba dang*/ kha che'i yul du slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dbyangs dang*/ rtog gi gi sa chos 'byug byin dang*/ 'dul 'dzin seng ge'i gdong pa can sogs byung*/ de las slob dpon seng ge bzang po ni rgyal po'i rigs las rab tu byung ba/

gzhung lugs la mkhyen pa rgyas shing*/ slob dpon zhi ba 'tsho la dbu ma dang*/ mkhan po snam snang mdzad la sher phyin gsan/ rgyal ba mi pham pa sgrub pas mnal lam du zhal bstan nas/ sher phyin gyi don 'brel bar byed pa'i 274)bstan bcos grub mtha' mi gcig pa mang nas/ su'i rjes su 'brang zhus pas 'thad dpa'i cha bsdus shig ces bka'i gnang ba thob/ rgyal po dharma pā las spyan drangs nas tsha ba gsum gyi gtsug lag khang du bzhugs te sher phyin nyan pa stong phag mang po la chos ston cing*/ brgyad stong 'grel chen sogs bstan bcus mang du mdzad pa sogs 'gro phan rgya che bar grags/ slob dpon rgya mtsho'i spyin ni/ rgyal ba ma pham pa'i zhal gzigs nas sa sde lnga la 'grel pa mdzad par yang grags shing byang pa'i 'grel pa ni grags che'o/ pad+ma 'byung gnas dbyangs ni lo dri mkhan po yin nam sems/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs ni/ seng bzang gi slob ma'i thog ma yin/ mi ring bar grub pa thob/ rgyal po'i bla mar gyur/ slob dpon 'di la nub re bzhin dzam bha las gser pā na bdun brgya re dang nor rgyun mas mu tig do shal sum brgya re 275)'bul zhing*/ lha'i mthus de dag nyo ba yang phyi de nyin kho nar 'byung la/ de thams cad dge ba'i las ma zad par mdzad nas tshul des dus 'da' bar mdzad de/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa lha bcu dgu la mar me shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam bdun bdun/ byang sems brgyad dang khro bo drug la gsum gsum/ phyogs skyong chen po bco lnga la gtor ma mi gnyis kyi 'khyogs kyis 'degs pa bco lnga re star ma chag pa 'bul zhing*/ chos nyan pa'i slob ma dang*/ rab tu byung ba dang*/ slong mo ba la sogs pa thams cad sbyin pas tshim par mdzad par grags/ slob dpon 'dis kṛ gsum dang*/ 'dus pa mod/ sgrul/ mnyam sbyor/ zla gsang thig le/ 'jam dpal khros pa ste nang gi rgyud sde yang mang du gsungs/

khyad par gsang ba 'dus pa rtsal bton du dar bar mdzad do/ 276)rgyal rigs sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po ni/ rigs gnas la sbyangs pas paṇ+ḍi ta'i gnas thob/ sangs rgyas ye shes kyis dbang bskur zhing byin gyis rlobs/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub pa mdzad pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i zhal gzigs/ gsang ba'i bdag po dngos su 'grub/ 'dzam bu'i gling du 'gro don cher ma mdzad 'gro lding gi yul du byon nas gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde mang du gsungs shing*/ klu rnams 'dul bar bzhed nas rgya mtsho'i 'gram du byon te da lta 'ang bzhugs par grags/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba ni/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi slob ma yin/ wa ra ṇā sir 'jam dpal sgrub pas nam zhig na bris sku gzhad/ dngos grub kyi rdzas ba dmar ser gyi mar yang khol me tog rnying pa rnams kha 'bus pas dngos grub kyi ltas su mkhyen yang*/ thog mar me tog 'bul lam mar khu 'thung snyams the tshom 277)du cung zad lus pa/ gnod sbyin mo zhig gis gegs byas te/ slob dpon gyi 'gram par thal phyag rgyab pas slob dpon cung zad brgyal/ brgyal ba sad tsam na bris sku rdul gyis gos so/ me tog rnyings/ mar khu yang bo/ 'on kyang rdul phyis/ me tog dbu la phul/ mar khu gang yod 'thungs pas sku lus nad thams cad dang bral zhing*/ stobs dang ldan pa/ blo gros rno ba/ mngon shes dang ldan pa byung*/ sangs rgyas zhi bas rdzas dang bris sku sogs gang gis kyang spros pa med par sgoms pas kyang sangs rgyas gsang ba dang yon tan mtshungs pa thob/ slob dpon de gnyis re bo ta lar byon/ ri'i rtsa bar 'phags ma sgrol ma klu'i tshogs la chos ston par bzhugs pa rgan mo ba glang gi khyung chen po 'tsho bar mthong*/ ri sked na khro gnyer can ma lha min dang gnod sbyin gyi tshogs la 278)chos ston pa bu mo ra lugs 'tsho bar gzigs/ ri'i rtser byon pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sku rdo sku las ma gzigs/

sangs rgyas zhi bas rang las snang ma dag pa yin gnas 'di na phal pa ga la yod snyam yid ches chen po byas nas gsol ba btab pas thun mongs kyi dngos grub mngon shes sogs dang mchog gi dngos grub gnas lugs nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i don rtogs pa gcig byung*/ sangs rgyas gsang ba yid ma ches bzhin du gsol ba btab pas/ zhabs sa la ma reg par 'gro ba tsam gyi dngos grub thob/ der rgan mo des/ khyod rang ri kha ba can gyi gangs ti ser song la sgrub pa gyis zhes lung bstan pa bzhin byon nas/ ti ser sgrub pa mdzad pas rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po yang nas yang du zhal gzigs shing*/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal dang mi lab pa bzhin du byung*/ de'i tshe 279)bod kyi btsan po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis dbas mañdzu shrī la sogs pa spyen du btang yang 'jam dpal gyis bka' ma gnang bas ma byon/ der kri yog sde gsum gyi bshad pa/ rdo rje dbyings kyi sgrub thabs yo ga la 'jug pa/ rnam snang mngon byang gi bsdus 'grel/ bsam gtan phyi ma'i rgyas 'grel la sogs pa bstan bcos mang du mdzod do/ de rjes rtog ge pa chos mchog dang*/ dharma mi tra dang*/ dharma ka ra la sogs pa byung*/ 'di tsam na rags rtsis su byas na bod na po khri ral sku 'das pa tsam gyi dus yin par bshad/ de rjes grub thob ti li pa dang slob dpon kun dga' snying po yang byung*/ de rjes shes rab 'byung gnas sbas pa/ yo ga lcags kyu pad+ma/ dze ta ri/ nag po dam tshig rdo rje/ slob dpon tha ga pa la sogs pa byung bar grags/ de nas bram ze ye shes zhabs dang nag 280)po spyod pa chung ba yang byung*/ 'di tsam na bod na bstan pa phyi dar gyi mgo tsam pa sa rags rtsis byas na mnyam par bshad/ de nas mkhas pa sgo drug byung ba la/ bi kra ma la'i gtsug lag khang na bzhugs pa ste/ shar na shap+te pa/ lho nang gi dbang phyug grags pa/ nub pa sher 'byug blo gros/

byang na nā ro paṇa chen/ dbus na rin chen rdo rje dang*/ dz+nyā na shrī rnams las/ shin+ta pa'i lo rgyus ma mthong ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa ni dge 'dun phal chen pa yin cing*/ sgra tshad dang gzhung lug du ma mkhyen cing*/ ngag gi dbang phyug gi dngos grub sgrubs ni 'grub bam mi 'grub snyam brtag pa mdzad pas 'grub par mkhyen nas gaṅga'i 'gram du bsgrubs bas/ shing ka ra wi ri'i me tog dmar po sgra dag 'od 'byin pa de gaṅgā la 'phangs/ dpag tshad mang por yud kyis khyer nas/ slar yang gyen du 281)ldog pas de nyid chu dang bcas pa gsol bas ngag gi dbang phyug chen po 'grub ste/ nyin rer tshigs bcad stong phag re'i gzhung gi tshin don mkhyen par nus pa'i blo gros byung bas ngag gi dbang phyug ces mtshan gsol/ 'chad rtsod brtsom gsum dag mdo sngags rigs gnas mtha' dag phul du phyin/ khyad par 'phags ma sgrol mas zhal bsnyan nas the tshoms gcod pa byung mu stegs tshar gcod pa zhes pa'i grags pas khyab pas/ rgyal pos spyan drangs nas na len+d+ra dang bi kra ma la shrī la'i lho sgo bsrung bar bskos/ chos kyi phrin las dang rdzu 'phrul gyi mdzad pa mtha' yas/ nub sgong bsrung ba song shes rab 'byug gnas blo gros ni/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la mkhas shing 'jam dpal gyi zhal gzigs pas/ mu stegs dang rtsod pa'i tshe 'jam dpal yid la dran zhing gsol ba btab pa 282)tsam gyis mu stegs kyi rtsod pa ji ltar zer ba dang*/ de'i lan 'debs tshul gnyis car thugs la shar nas brtsod pa nges par rgyal ba zhig yod par grags so/ sher 'byung blo gros dang sher 'byung sbas pa gnyis gcig par 'dod pa'i 'khrul pa yang 'di ni rten dge slong yin la/ sher 'byung sbas pa ni dge bsnyen no/ byang sgo bsrung ba nā ro pa ni/ rdzu 'phrul zla dang bral/ slob ma ni rtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa pas chos gsan dbang lung sogs rjes su gdams pa shin tu mang bar gnang dngos grub kyang bsnyes/

skabs shig na nā ro pas thod pa gcig bsnams te/ skye bo kun la slong ba ltar mdzad pa la/ chom po gcig gis thod pa'i nang du gri chung gcig bskyur/ nā ro pas lta stangs mdzad pas mar zhu ba ltar bstems kyi zhu nas gsol te song*/ gzhi mdo na glang chen shi ba'i ror grong 'jug mdzad re dur khrod du bskyal te kho bo 283)rnal 'byor pa yin pa'i rtags de ltar yin/ mkhas pa chen po yang rtags ston par mi spro'am zhes shin+tā pa la gnang bas/ bdag lta bus ci 'tshal te/ 'on kyang khyed lta bus snang na bya'o gsung*/ chu'i bum pa thogs pa 'ga' slebs byung bar chu la sngags re btab pas thams cad gser zhun mar song*/ der dge 'dun rnams dang bram ze rnams la byin par grags so/ de nas nā ro pas byang sgo bsrung b.lo 'ga' zhig mdzad nas rnal 'byor la gshegs so/ de rjes de'i tshab gnas brtan byang bzang gis mdzad/ de ni spyan ras gzigs 'grub nas zhal gzigs te chos dngos su gsan pa gcig go/ dbus kyi ka chen dang po bram ze rin rin chen rdo rje ni/ sngon kha che'i yul du bram ze zhig gi lha dbang phyug sgrubs pas khyod kyi rigs rgyud la mkhas pa grags ldan sha stag 'byung ngo zhes 284)lung bstan thob pa ltar lo grangs nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i bar du mu stegs kyi grub mtha' la mkhas par gyur/ rtsa lnga pa des sangs rgyas pa dang bstan pa dpang du gcug ste rtsod pas phams te nang pa la zhugs/ chos kyang mkhas par mkhyen pa'i paṇ+ḍi tar gyur/ de'i sras rin chen rdo rje 'di yin zhing*/ chung ngu nas mdo sngags rigs gnas thams cad la mkhas par gyur/ sde bdun dang byams chos sde latha la 'chad nyan gtso bor mdzad/ mu stegs mang po zhig rtsod pas srun phyungs nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la btsud/ sku tshe'i smad o rgyan gyi yul du byon nas dbang phyug gi zhal mthong ba'i mu stegs pa zhig yod pa rtsod pas 'phams te nang pa'i nang pa'i bstan pa la btsud phyis dngos grub kyang thob te bod du byon pa'i ā tsar+ya dmar po grags pa de yin/

dbus kyi ka chen gnyis pa dz+nyā na shrī mi tra ste/ mtha' gnyis sel ba'i bstan bcos mdzad 285)mkhan de yin/ dpal a ti sha'i sku drin che ba'i bla ma gcig yin/ klu sgrub dang thogs med kyi gzhung la mkhas par sbyangs/ khyad par mdo rgyud kyi gsan rgya shin tu che/ rtag tu byang chub kyi sems la gom pas shākya'i rgyal po dang*/ byams pa dang*/ spyan ras gzigs yang yang zhal gzigs/ mngon shes thogs med mnga'/ lan gcig bi kra ma lar bzhugs skabs slob ma dge tshul zhig yod pa der byang chub chen po bzhugs pa'i gan+dho la la me'i gnod pa 'ong ba 'dug pas khyod myur bar song la nyi ma gung la ga ya'i grong du slebs pa gyis/ der rdo rje gdan gyi dge 'dun dang dkon gnyer rnams bram ze zhig gis dus ston la bos nas yod de rnams khrid la me rnol zhig gsung*/ des der phyin nas kho bo'i slob dpon gyis lung bstan pa yin pas 'byon par bzhengs 286)zhes gsol bas/ phyed tsam yid ma ches par bsdad/ lhag ma phyed tsam dang bcas rdo rje'i gdan du song bas rdo rje gdan gyi gan+dho la la me shor te/ phyi nang kun tu 'bar gyin 'dug der lha la gsol ba 'debs kyin me bsad pas lha khang zhig sa cher ma byung*/ ri mo gzugs pa dang shing tshig pa rnams slob dpon gyis gsos pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa mtha' yas so/ mkhas pa sgo drug 'das pa'i 'og tu/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha mkhan por spyan drangs/ 'dis o ran+ta pu ri yang bskyangs/ de nas mnga' bdag mi tri'i 'phris yang dar ba yin/ de nas lo mang zhig song ba dang slob dpon a bha ya ka ra dang*/ kha che'i yul du paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shākya shri bha dra dang chos 'byung zhi ba dang*/ bud+dha shri dang*/ badz+ra shri la sogs pa'i paṇa grub rnams dang*/ a bha ya ka dang*/ nā ro pa'i slob rgyud la sogs 287)pa rnams kyis bstan pa bskyangs bar mdzad do/

de nas lo mang tsam song ba na mu stegs pa 'phel tshes shing stag gcig dang kla klo'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa yang mang du byung bas rdo rje gdun du theg chen gyi grwa ma tshugs/ o ran+ta pu ri dang bi kra ma la shrī lar yang rgyal pos rdzong gi rnam cung zad byas te dmag gis bsrung ba byung*/ de nas lo 'ga' zhig 'das pa na gaṅga dang ya mu na'i bar gyi yul an+tar bhi di'i yul du ruṣ+ka'i rgyal po zla ba zhes bya ba byung*/ dge slong 'ga' res rgyal po pho nya byas pas rkyen blangs te/ yul gzhan dang gzhan na gnas pa'i rgyal phran mang po phyogs gcig tu bsdus te/ ma gha dha'i yul thams cad btsoms/ o tan+ta pu ri'i rab tu byung ba mang po zhig bsad/ de dang bi kra ma la gnyis ka bshig shul du stag gzig gis rdzong bcas/ paṇ+ḍi ta shākya 288)shrī shar phyogs su byon/ der lo gsum bzhugs nas bod du byon pa yin/ paṇa chung brgya tsam nub phyogs kyi yul du byon/ stobs bcu mnga' ba'i slob dpon badz+ra shri dang paṇa chung mang po lho phyogs thag ring po'i sar bros/ ma gha dh+ra bstan pa nub pa ltar gyur ro/ de skabs grub pa thob pa dang*/ rdzu 'phrul ston nus pa mang zhig yod kyang*/ sems can spyi mthun gyis las la bzlog thabs ma byung bar grags/ de rjes bhaṃ ga la'i yul du tsa ga la ra tsa zhes bya ba zhugs chen po gcig byung*/ des tu ruṣ+ka thams cad la dbang bsgyur/ de dang po bram ze la dad pa gcig yin yang*/ btsun mo sangs rgyas la dad pas blo bsgyur te/ de rdo rje gdan du mchod pa chen po byas/ lha khang thams cad la zhig gsos dang*/ gan+dho chen po dgu thog yod pa'i thog bzhi bar skabs tu ruṣ+kas bshig pa legs par gsos/ paṇ+ḍi ta sha ri pu tra bzhugs te chos gzhi gtsugs 289)na len+d+rar yang mchod pa chen po byas/ 'on kyang chos gzhi rgya chen po ni ma tshugs/ rgyal po 'di tshe ring po byung bar grags/

'di 'das nas lo brgya dang drug cu tsam song ba nas ma gha dha'i yul du chos la spyod pa ma byugs bar grags so/ chos 'byung bstan pa'i ma las/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi skabs te dang pa'o/ gnyis pa gangs can bod kyi yul 'dir bstan pa dam ba'i chos ji ltar byung ba'i tshul/ 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ nga yi dus nas lo brgya na/ kha ba can du mtsho bri nas/ sā la'i nags ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ zhes thog mar mtshos gang ba rim gyis bris nas shug pa la sogs pa'i nags chags pa'i sā la'i ljongs su grags shing yul du rung bar gyur nas/ dang po mi ma yin gyis rim par bdag tu bzung ba ste/ de yang thog mar gnod sbyin gyis bzung 290)ste/ yul ming bzang yul rgyan med dang*/ de nas bdud bzung ste/ bdud yul kha rag mgo dgu/ de nas srin pos bzung ste/ srin po nag po dgu yul/ de nas lhas bzung ste/ lha yul gung thang*/ de nas dmus bzung ste/ 'phrang rtse 'phrang yul/ de nas 'dres bzung ste/ lang thang ling thang*/ de nas ma bzang spun dgus bzung ste/ bod yul nya kha drug de nas klus bzung ste/ bod khams gling dgu/ de nas rgyal pos bzung ste/ dam pa rtse yul/ de nas mgon po spu dgus bzung ste/ stong sde bco rgyad ces yul ming du grags pa 'di nyid ni/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i yal gyal du byed pa bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ bod yul du ni lhan skyes te/ zhi zhing gsal ba'i gzugs can ma/ chu srin rgyan mtshan lag na thogs/ brag gi khyim la brten te gnas/ rang byung gi ni skye gnas can/ zhes gsungs so/ de yang 291)slob dpon shes rab go cha'i lha las phul byung gi 'grel pa las/ skya seng bu lnga dang dgra ngan dpung tshogs yan lag bcu gnyis 'thabs pa'i tshe/ rgyal po ru pa ti zhes dmag stong phrag gcig dang bcas bud med kyi chas su zhugs te ri gangs can gyis dbus su bros pa las mched par bshad cing yongs su grags pa spyir 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi rigs la phyi bar nang gsum las rgyal rigs/

rje rigs bram ze'i rigs/ dmangs rigs te phyi rigs bzhi/ rgya gar lha/ rgya nag klu/ hor lha min/ bod spre'u dang brag srin ma ste bar gyi rigs bzhi/ de yang spre'u dang brag srin gnyis 'dus pa'i */ nub phyogs bde ba can na sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la/ bod kha bcan gyi rgyal khabs zhes bya ba ston pa shākya thub pa'i dngos kyis gdul byar ma gyur pa yod pas de dag la khyod 292)kyis chos kyi sbyin pas thul gcig ces gsungs pa ltar/ spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa spre'u zhig dang rdze btsun sgrol ma'i sprul pa brag srin ma gnyis 'dus pa las/ spre'u phrug mjug ma med pa sprus khengs pa gdong dmar bsrug byung ba gcig lha las tshe 'phos pa ngang rgyud dang byad bzhin bzang ba/ lha min nas tshe 'phos pa thu la phra dgo che ba/ mi nas tshe 'phos pa sems chung shes rab rgyas pa/ yi dwags nas 'phos pa lus ngan pa zas la srid cing ser sna che ba/ dud 'gro nas 'phos pa legs zhan med pa'i glen pa gcig dmyal ba nas 'phos pa ngo nag pa bzhin mi sdug pa sdug sran che ba rnams byung*/ de rnams 'phel te bzhi brgya long de tshan pa bzhir 'thabs pa dang ming bso bar mtshams byas te zhing la cha bzhir bgos gcig la gcig 'jigs nas tshan pa bzhir byas pas/ se dang*/ rmu dang*/ ldong 293)dang*/ stong ste nang gi mi'u rigs bzhi dang*/ yang 'ga' zhig tu dbra dang 'bru bsnan pa'i drug sogs bzhed tshul mang zhing dus der rgyal phran bcu gnyis dang bsil ma bcu gcig rnams kyis dbang byas par bshad kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spel ba ma byung*/ rigs gsum mgon po dang sgrib pa rnam sel dang*/ kun tu bzang po sogs kyis rnams 'phrul gyi chos kyi rgyal pos bod kyi 'gro ba 'dul ba lung bstan pa ltar/ bod spyi la dbang ba'i rgyal po'i thog ma rgya gar gyi rgyal podamag brgya pa'i sras mig mas 'gebs g.yu'i smin ma dang dung so 'khor ma lag pa'i mthil du 'khor lo'i ri mo yod pa'i mi las 'das pa zhig btsas pa lha 'dre'i sprul par dgos nas spyugs pa lha ri gyang tho'i rtser byon nas gzigs pa na yar klung yul gyi dge mtshan phun sum tshogs pa dang*/

sham po'i gangs ri dpyad bzang bar mkhyen 294)nas lha ri rol po'i steng nas lha skas brgyud btsan thang sgo bzhir byon pas phyugs skyong ba sogs kyis mthong ste dris pa na gnam la mdzub mo ker bas lhar ngos nas gnya' bar kri byas gdan drangs pas gnya' khri btsan por grags/ de nas rgyal rabs nyer bdun 'das pa na lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan pho brang yum bu gla sgang na bzhugs pa'i tshe dpang skongs phyag rgya pa/ gser gyi mchod rten/ mdo sde za ma tog gi snying po yi ge drug ma/ tshen+dha ma ṇi'i rkos phor rnams pho brang gi yang thog tu babs pa na dam pa chos kyi dbu brnyes/ gang yin mi shes kyang bzang por go ste gnyan po gsang bar btags nas mchod pa rgya cher mdzad pas rgyal po slar gzhon sha can du gyur nas lo bzhi bcu 'phar bas kun dril lo brgya dang nyi shu thub/ de yang rgyal po dzaḥ'i khang steng du glegs bam gyi char babs tshe mod za ma tog rlung gi khyer nas yum bu gla sgang gi rtser
